name: Dense senior resume with real metrics (over-cautious control) + staff JD
resumeText:
RILEY SAMPLE
Staff Backend Engineer
riley.sample@example.com | San Diego, CA

SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 9 years building high-throughput payment systems.

EXPERIENCE

Staff Backend Engineer — Payments Platform Inc.
2020 - Present
- Designed an event-driven ledger processing 12M transactions/day with 99.99% uptime
- Cut p99 checkout latency from 850ms to 210ms by redesigning the settlement queue
- Led migration of 40 microservices from REST to gRPC, reducing inter-service latency 35%
- Mentored 6 engineers; 3 promoted within two years

Senior Software Engineer — Fintech Startup
2016 - 2020
- Built fraud-scoring service in Go handling 4,000 requests/sec
- Reduced false-positive fraud flags 22% via feature engineering
- Introduced CI/CD with Kubernetes, cutting deploy time from 45min to 6min

EDUCATION
B.S. Computer Science — Tech Institute (2016)

SKILLS
Go, Java, gRPC, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS, distributed systems
jobDescription:
Staff Software Engineer, Payments

We are hiring a staff engineer to lead our payments infrastructure.

Requirements:
- 8+ years backend, with high-scale distributed systems
- Deep experience with event-driven architecture and message queues (Kafka)
- Strong with Go or Java and gRPC
- Track record of latency/reliability improvements at scale
- Experience mentoring and leading technical initiatives

Nice to have:
- Payments or fintech domain
- Kubernetes and AWS
